description: Start your day with inspiration — 65 original motivational quotes, with a date-seeded “today's quote” plus shuffle.

faqs.a: 65 original motivational quotes written for this tool — no copied celebrity quotes.
The same quote is shown all day based on the date, so it works like a daily quote calendar — and everyone sees the same one.
Yes — press Shuffle for a random quote any time, or browse 10 at once.
faqs.q: Can I get a random quote too?

howto: Press Shuffle for a new random quote.
Press Show 10 to browse more; click any to copy.
title: Quote of the Day
